name: Girls Inc. Eureka! STEM program (YWCA Minneapolis)
org: Girls Inc. at YWCA Minneapolis, with University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering
what_you_do: Join a five year STEM program. It has summer camp at the University of Minnesota and YWCA Midtown, plus school year support. You explore STEM careers and meet mentors. In high school you can do a stipend internship.
grades: Grades 8 to 12 (the University of Minnesota page says students entering grades 8 and 9 can apply)
who_can_apply: Youth in grades 8 to 12 who like STEM, from across the Twin Cities. The University of Minnesota summer camps page says students entering grades 8 and 9 are eligible to apply. The page describes a pro-girl program. It does not say whether boys can join.
pay_detail: Eureka! interns get a stipend from Girls Inc. after completing a 4 week internship (20 hours a week). The amount is not stated. The cost of the summer program is not stated on the page.
duration: Summer camp about 4 weeks (2026: June 29 to July 24), Mon to Thu 8:45 a.m. to 4 p.m. and Fri to 2 p.m.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer dates were June 29 to July 24, 2026 (no camp July 4). The page says registration is currently closed. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Eureka! online application or the PDF application on the program page. Do this when registration opens. The PDF comes in English, Spanish or Somali. Contact: girlsinc@ywcampls.org or 612-215-4369.
notes: Described as a pro-girl program (Girls Inc.), so ask whether it is for girls only. Interns are treated as volunteers by the worksite because the stipend comes from Girls Inc., not the worksite. Minnesota work permit rules were not checked.
